inspection_method: local git checkout; inspected README, C source model, recipe constructors, ingredient constructors, generated site, assets, and build script

anchors.why: Identifies the repository as website sources written in C and gives the local build command.
Defines Recipe, RecipePart, Serving, and helper functions such as create_recipe, create_part, add_instruction, and add_serving.
Stores recipes as typed constructor calls with parts, instructions, ingredient links, dates, time, and portion strings.
Defines ingredients and child ingredients with descriptions and crosslinks to related ingredients or nutrition pages.
Formats, compiles with strict warning flags and sanitizers, generates the site, and removes the binary.

known_limits: The C content-generator approach is too heavy for VAKS Markdown-first mainline.
Ingredient descriptions and nutrition-like text are not reviewed evidence for VAKS.
Generated site pages are outputs, not source-of-truth records.
